title: Local permutation tests for conditional independence: an adaptive binning perspective
summary: In this work, we study the problem of testing conditional independence between random variables $X$ and $Y$ given a confounder $Z$. The local permutation test (LPT) offers a principled approach to this problem by partitioning the $Z$-space into pre-specified bins, and permuting the $X$ and $Y$ data within each bin, to assess the significance of an observed test statistic. However, when the partitions are pre-fixed, the resulting partition can be poorly balanced, as some bins may contain most of the samples while others contain only a few. This motivates the use of data-adaptive binning…
